scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run db:setup
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
